note:
METHOD (about 70 tool calls, 0 WebSearch). One background script queried all 315 composers: MusicBrainz artist search (ten composers per request, matched on name and on dates against the candidates' years) and, for each matched artist, every work with its linked recordings (200 works at most); Deezer album search on 'Given Surname' (plus '<Surname> quartet' and '<Surname> trio' where the first search returned more than 25 albums), filtered by script for the surname and chamber words; Apple's composerTerm song search for every composer without a chamber-titled Deezer album of their own (the others had one), and a second Apple pass for composers with a hit, to find their other pages on mixed discs. Hits were opened through Deezer album and Apple lookup track lists, MusicBrainz recordings and releases, Apple Music album pages (the iTunes API gives no composer field, the web page does) and IMSLP's api.php. MusicBrainz was slow all run (shared clock), so the Apple queue was ordered by publishers' signals.
